title: Monopoly: Game Night Goes Terribly Wrong!
description:
On November 26th, 2022, at 4:24 pm, Tulsa Police Department responded to an incident where reported shots had been fired in the residence. When officers arrived, they spoke to two witnesses who also resided at the house and were standing on a street nearby. They told officers that another household member had fired a round at them during a game of Monopoly.

The suspect was arrested and later charged with Assault with a Deadly Weapon.
